summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his detailed instruction on the proper technique of recitation and transition between positions during prayer. He addresses a common mistake regarding the timing of the takbir (Allahu Akbar) during transitions between prayer positions, explaining that this takbir should occur during the movement itself, not before or after the transition is complete. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that the ideal position for followers is to watch the imam and begin moving only after the imam has fully arrived and settled in the next position, following the example of how the Companions prayed behind the Prophet. He argues against modifying proper prayer technique to accommodate ignorance or large congregations, stressing the importance of education and correct practice, particularly in smaller communities where habits can be established correctly from the beginning before they become difficult to change.
suggested_title: The Proper Timing of Takbir During Prayer Transitions and Following the Imam Correctly
catchy_title: When Should You Say Allahu Akbar During Prayer?
